# Add a route to apps/web

Conventions live in `apps/web/AGENTS.md`; read it first. This file is only the ordering that matters.

**Plan around this:** `apps/web/src/route-tree.ts` is generated by the `tanstackRouter` plugin in
`apps/web/vite.config.ts`, and **only the user regenerates it**. Every Vite run of `apps/web` rewrites
it — `pnpm dev`, `vite build`, and the `pnpm dev:test` that `pnpm test:e2e` boots. Until the user
regenerates, `tsc` fails on your new file with:

```
error TS2345: Argument of type '"/_app/your-route"' is not assignable to parameter of type 'keyof FileRoutesByPath | undefined'.
```

That error is the expected state of a correct new route. Never hand-edit `route-tree.ts` and never
run the generator.

## Steps

1. **Choose the filename** under `apps/web/src/routes/`; the path on disk is the URL (naming rules in
   `apps/web/AGENTS.md` §Routes). Put it under `_app/` unless it must render without auth —
   `_app/route.tsx` redirects unauthenticated users.

2. **Write the file.** `_app/admin/branding/login-page.tsx` is the minimal shape;
   `_app/admin/audit/logs.tsx` is the full one (search params, loader, nested components).

3. **Make the `createFileRoute` literal match the file path exactly**, leading `/_app` included —
   `createFileRoute('/_app/admin/audit/logs')` for `_app/admin/audit/logs.tsx`. A mismatch raises the
   same TS2345 and, unlike a stale tree, survives regeneration.

4. **If the route reads search params, add `validateSearch`** with a Zod schema — from
   `@opendatacapture/schemas` (`logs.tsx`) or an inline `z.object` (`_app/upload/$instrumentId.tsx`).
   Without it, `Route.useSearch()` has nothing to return.

5. **If the loader depends on search params, write `loaderDeps` before `loader`**, with the disable
   comment from `logs.tsx`:

   ```ts
   loaderDeps: ({ search }) => ({ search }),
   // eslint-disable-next-line perfectionist/sort-objects -- TanStack Router infers the loader's `deps` from loaderDeps, so loaderDeps must come first
   loader: async ({ context, deps }) => { ... }
   ```

   Sorted the other way, `deps` infers as `{}` and `deps.search` fails with TS2339.

6. **Prefetch in the loader** with `context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(<hook>QueryOptions(...))`,
   passing the factory the same params the component passes the hook, or the prefetched entry is
   never read. No hook yet: `.agents/docs/playbooks/add-web-data-hook.md`.

7. **If the route needs a nav entry, add it to `apps/web/src/hooks/useNavItems.ts`**, guarded by the
   right `ability.can(...)`. `NavItem.url` is a plain `string`, so a wrong URL compiles and 404s —
   copy it from the `createFileRoute` literal.

8. **Add a `data-testid`** to whatever the e2e test will click or assert on.

9. **Ask the user to regenerate the route tree**, and name it in your reply as work they still owe.
   Until then `pnpm lint` fails in two workspaces: TS2345 in `apps/web`, and in `testing`, whose
   `gen:routes` derives the `RouteTo` union from that tree, so your literal is not yet a valid
   `pageModels` key. `gen:routes` reads `route-tree.ts` and never writes it, so it is yours to run
   (`pnpm --filter @opendatacapture/testing gen:routes`); `testing`'s `lint` and `test:e2e` also run
   it first.

10. **Add the tests.** A unit test named after the route file, in a `__tests__/` folder beside it
    (`routes/_app/admin/__tests__/mail.test.tsx` tests `routes/_app/admin/mail.tsx`), and an e2e test
    — `.agents/docs/playbooks/add-e2e-test.md`.

## Verify

```sh
pnpm --filter @opendatacapture/web lint   # TS2345 on your literal alone means the tree is not regenerated yet
pnpm exec vitest --project web
pnpm test:e2e
```

Run `pnpm test:e2e` after the user has regenerated: it boots `apps/web` through Vite, which rewrites
`route-tree.ts`. If `git status` then lists that file, revert it.
